name: What is the process for starting a bathroom refresh project with your company?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for starting a bathroom refresh project with your company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. We then provide a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work, material suggestions, and a clear timeline. Once approved, we assist with material selection, schedule the work, and manage the project from start to finish. Our team ensures clear communication throughout to minimize disruption and deliver your refreshed bathroom efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, detailed proposal, material selection, scheduling, and project management with continuous communication.
